column3: Normalize issue project refs to the project id: resolve with projectByRef on create (unknown is bad_args) and on the list filter; rewrite legacy slug rows lazily on the first boot with one UPDATE per project whose slug differs from its id, marked done in issue_meta so later boots cost one primary-key read
column4: A live run stored the slug ingle, so the Overview's issue.list {project:<id>} showed 0. Plugin SqliteMigration steps are SQL-only and cannot read WorkspaceDoc, so a migration step cannot map slug to id
